title: The Invoices import lists the columns Line Title and Line Description
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions, including Settings → Data Import) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings.
  2. Read the list of imports under Data Import in the Settings sidebar.
  3. Click Invoices.
  4. Read the list of columns shown on the page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: the imports listed are Contacts, Assets, Vendors, Inventory and Invoices. There is no separate work order import.
  • Step 4: the column list shows "Line Title" and "Line Description" next to each other, after Item and before Tech Story, and nowhere says "What are you doing" or "Why are you doing it".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10133 (Story 4, The Imports); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S4-R1, S4-R2, S4-R6, read 13 Oct 2026; no design board exists for this story (tech plan: Story 2 and Story 4 are text-only), labels from the Jira story and tech plan; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-015, FR-017 and Phase 4; Product comment by Chris Ward, 23 Sep 2026 (Confluence comment 883261444); Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R1: “Withdrawn. There is no separate work order import. The only live import carrying these columns is Administration → Invoices, which writes to the imported work order history and is covered by S4-R2. The column names this requirement renamed exist only in code nothing calls, and nothing ships for them.”
  • S4-R2: “The historical invoice import's two columns (Administration → Invoices) are named "*Line Title" and "Line Description", replacing "*Line Title - What are you doing" and "Line Description - Why are you doing it".”
  • S4-R6: “The downloadable sample file and the on-screen column list both show the new names.”
  • SV-10133 acceptance criteria: “Given the on-screen column list is viewed, then it shows the new names.”
  • Tech plan Phase 4: “Banner prose `:87-88` → `… Item, Line Title, Line Description, Tech Story, …`; template header `:249` → `…,*Item,*Line Title,Line Description,Tech Story,…`. Only those two tokens change; the other 22 columns and the order stay byte-identical”
